output.scope_note: The paper is a first-principles study of Li-ion diffusion in brownmillerite Li_xSr2Co2O5 as a candidate solid electrolyte, and it reports room-temperature ionic conductivities computed in this work.

records.measurement_method: DFT with cl-NEB migration barriers and Vineyard hopping-frequency estimate (computed, not measured)
records.evidence_quote: 1.02 × 10−7 cm2 s−1 and 1.20 × 10−3 S · cm−1 for x = 0.25 respectively
records.notes: Computed value, not measured. Conductivity assumes n = one Li+ per unit cell and adiabatic diffusion (Eqs. 1-2). Activation energy is the cl-NEB migration barrier (0.28 eV), which the paper uses as Ea in Eq. 2. Room temperature is given in the paper as T = 300 K; left null for the Celsius field. Strong-scattering alternative (0.88 × 10−3 S · cm−1) not recorded.
